data.body:
Fixes bug B-baseline-red-reach-counts-whole-tree-guards: complete refused SW-pilot-toy on unit_tests although all 90 failures were measured on base 968df7545 with new_failures empty and none names this item's files: accept_baseline_red rejects a failing test file the item 'changes or reaches', and the four named (test_architecture_import_contracts, test_command_registry, test_file_size_ratchet, test_uc_surf_setup_ops_transcript) are whole-tree guards or pins that any source change reaches. So while one such guard is red on main, no item touching source can complete without a person, whatever the measurement says, and the merged item sits open, claimable by B-merged-uncompleted-claimable. Direction: for a whole-tree guard compare the failure itself (the same assertion on base and candidate), or exclude [ci].always_tests from reach. Regression test: a guard red on base and candidate with the same message does not block completion. Found on SW-pilot-toy.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-baseline-red-reach-counts-whole-tree-guards --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-baseline-red-reach-counts-whole-tree-guards --regression-test <test>` first).

Findings from lane fix-reach (2026-11-05, never claimed: the claim was refused on ddflow/api/gate_baseline.py, held by sw-ciguards; stopped under D-unwind-for-kilo-2026-11-05). Nothing landed. Draft patch against main 954c62638 era: scratchpad fix-reach/fix-reach.patch (session scratchpad, may not survive).

Globs: the filed ones are wrong. The code is in ddflow/services/gates/baseline.py (auto_decision), plus new ddflow/services/gates/baseline_same.py, ddflow/services/testselect.py, ddflow/services/flakes.py, ddflow/api/gate_baseline.py, ddflow/api/gates/_run.py, tests/test_baseline_red*.py, README.md, docs/ddflow/constants-exemptions.toml, and the docstring of auto_ids in ddflow/services/gate_accept.py.

Root cause, measured on SW-pilot-toy (select f81011f39 against ea6df09bb): auto_decision treats the whole SELECTION as reach, but the decision says 'changed or imports'. The four tests were picked by text, not import: test_architecture_import_contracts by GOVERNS, test_command_registry, test_file_size_ratchet and test_uc_surf_setup_ops_transcript by a changed phrase. Only the last is in [ci].always_tests, so excluding always_tests would not fix it.

Design in the draft: (1) Selection.imported = tests the import walk reached (rank cannot say this: a later text pick lowers it). (2) Changed, rank RANK_CHANGED (changed conftest) or imported: stays excluded, no comparison. (3) Picked only by text: accepted only if the failure text matches the base. This is a strict subset of the decision, so it does not widen it. (4) baseline_same.compare runs those ids on both sides with one command plus --tb=short -vvv, reads whole failure sections (flakes.failure_sections, split out of failure_tails), compares E lines per section, sorted. Normalised: tree path, pytest tmp dir, 0x addresses only. Unmeasured, no text, passed on rerun or over the cap: not the same. Gate stays partial. rerun gains keep_output. Pass the comparer POSITIONALLY: tests/test_ci_guards_after_red_selection.py fakes auto_decision with lambda *a.

Why not the short reason: pytest cuts FAILED lines to terminal width and drops them for long ids (the ratchet's had none). -vv is not enough: the gate's -q takes one -v back and left 'Full output truncated (21 lines hidden)'; -vvv shows all. xdist prints sections in any order.

OPEN, needs the operator's word: replay of SW-pilot-toy's real trees (968df7545 vs f81011f39, 90 failing ids, 5 compared, about 1 min per side) STILL REFUSES. The other 4 ids showed no difference; test_import_contracts differs in one line only: 'Analyzed 1142 files, 8556 dependencies.' vs 8553. Under 'if the failure text differs, it is not accepted' that is a refusal, and the draft keeps it. So while that guard is red, items in the paths it governs still need a person. Options: fix that guard on main, drop the count from its assertion message, or a recorded operator rule for ignorable lines. None was taken.

State of the draft: tests/test_baseline_red_reach.py: on unfixed main 6 of 8 failed for the right reason, the 2 safety tests (truly new failure, changed test) passed as they should. With the fix, before the last test edit, 68 of 69 related tests passed; the one failure was a test relying on monkeypatch across run_cli, since rewritten (mute marker) and NOT re-run alone, though the 1205-test guard run below included it. Guard run: 1201 passed, 4 failed. Still to do: ddflow/services/gates/baseline_same.py:MAX_IDS needs a line in docs/ddflow/constants-exemptions.toml or a knob (failing test_no_new_unclassified_constant, and test_the_script_exits_clean_on_this_tree, which also names index_touch_s, not checked against main); test_file_size_ratchet and test_no_new_agent_literal failed on files this draft does not touch; remove the unused noqa on auto_decision (ruff); README paragraph not written; no review gate run. Limit to state: a guard that stops at its first offender hides a new one behind the same text. No base-text cache, so each gate run pays one scratch tree plus the guards.
